## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The mixed-case write defect should be fixed because `set` stores keys that `get` cannot retrieve. This review read both changed files and all existing tests; tests were not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds `Cache.set`, raises the default TTL from 60 to 300 seconds, and adds round-trip, default-value, and expiry tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Normalize keys before storing entries — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` followed by `get("ALPHA")` returns `None`. You store the original key, but `get` always looks up `key.lower()`, violating the documented case-insensitive behavior. The round-trip test writes only a lowercase key. — Callers using uppercase or mixed-case keys cannot retrieve their cached values.
